newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh border force on alert for likely influx.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh border force on alert for likely influx.

text.p: Bangladesh has put its border guards on alert because of a possible influx of Moslem refugees from Burma, state-run Radio Bangladesh said on Thursday.
"People along the 280 km (175 mile) border with Burma have also been asked to remain alert against fresh infiltration of Rohingya Moslems from Myanmar (Burma)," the broadcast said.
The radio requested Bangladesh citizens to inform the authorities immediately if people crossed the border.
